config.title: object-fit

intro.title: object-fit
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple image gallery to learn how to control how images fit within their containers. You will use the CSS `object-fit` property to adjust image scaling and cropping. The main technologies involved are CSS properties and HTML image elements. This beginner-friendly lesson will help you make images look perfect in any layout.
intro.usecase: The object-fit property is essential for managing image and video content in responsive web layouts. Developers use it in e-commerce product galleries to ensure product images maintain consistent aspect ratios across different screen sizes. In social media feeds and content management systems, object-fit prevents portrait and landscape images from distorting when displayed in uniform grid containers. It's also crucial for hero banners and media-rich dashboards where visual consistency is required regardless of original media dimensions.

objectives: Apply the object-fit property to control how an image fills its container
Configure different object-fit values (fill, contain, cover, none, scale-down) to achieve specific visual outcomes
Manipulate image aspect ratios using object-fit in combination with width and height constraints
Implement responsive image layouts by adjusting object-fit values across different container sizes
Construct image galleries where object-fit ensures consistent presentation across varying image dimensions
Control image cropping behavior by selecting appropriate object-fit values for different design requirements
Initialize object-fit settings to maintain image proportions while filling designated spaces in layouts

steps.title: Introduce the object-fit property
steps.instruction: Add the object-fit property to the img selector in your CSS and set its value to 'fill'.
steps.hint: In the img selector inside the <style> tag, add object-fit: fill; to control how the image fits within its container.

<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Object-fit Demo</title>
    <style>
        /* Add your CSS for .image-container here */
        
        img {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            /* Add object-fit property here */
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>

</html>
